variants.setup: PRAGMA encoding='UTF-8';CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,a INTEGER,b INTEGER,c INTEGER,p TEXT);CREATE INDEX ab ON t(a,b);CREATE INDEX ci ON t(c);WITH RECURSIVE x(i) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM x WHERE i<20000) INSERT INTO t SELECT i,i%20,CASE WHEN i<=19800 THEN 0 ELSE i-19800 END,i%7,'payload-'||i FROM x;ANALYZE;

stat4.sql: SELECT id,p FROM t WHERE b>100 AND c=1
eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX ab (ANY(a) AND b>?)
